title: Introduction
description: Quarto documents with executable R code, rendered to Markdown and built with Zensical.
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
---

This site is written in Quarto (the `.qmd` files in `example/`). `quarto render`
executes the R code and writes Markdown to `docs/`, and `zensical build` turns
that into the site you are reading.

Test123

## A table from R

I will refer to @sec-tabsets 


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_tools <- tibble::tibble(
  tool = c("Quarto", "Zensical"),
  job = c("execute + render", "build site")
)
print(df_tools)
## # A tibble: 2 × 2
##   tool     job             
##   <chr>    <chr>           
## 1 Quarto   execute + render
## 2 Zensical build site
```
:::


## A figure {#sec-figure}


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_points <- tibble::tibble(x = 1:4, y = c(1, 4, 2, 3))

ggplot2::ggplot(df_points, ggplot2::aes(x, y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```
